description: pkix-path-builder/tests/bettertls.rs:106-153 is acknowledged in its rustdoc as "a deliberate copy of the inline parser in pkix-difftest/src/corpus/limbo.rs, kept here to avoid a dev-dep on pkix-difftest". The justification is real (pkix-difftest pulls in oracle backends as deps). The cost is real too: any bug fix to the RFC 3339 parser in pkix-difftest will not propagate to this copy, and any reader debugging a date-related test failure must remember to grep BOTH locations. Cleaner alternatives: (1) factor the parser into a tiny private workspace crate `pkix-test-time` with no deps beyond std, dev-dep both crates on it; (2) commit Unix-seconds directly in testcase.json so neither crate has to parse RFC 3339 (the extract.py script can do the conversion once). Option 2 is cleaner — it removes RFC 3339 parsing from the test path entirely, the python script already runs offline so a date-math bug there is caught at fixture generation time, not at test runtime. Suggested rewrite: in extract.py, also write `validation_time_unix` alongside the RFC 3339 string, and have bettertls.rs read that. Drop the rfc3339_to_unix function entirely. Code is testable: cross-check the new field against a few hand-computed values once.
title: bettertls.rs duplicates rfc3339_to_unix from pkix-difftest verbatim — diverge risk
